title: The past is not the whole test
lines: Two models can describe the same past and disagree the moment you try to change something.
From Rules, Worlds proposes a test of understanding: can the same explanation keep working when conditions change?
This research proposal explores the difference between describing an outcome and showing how it can happen.

title: What must a model preserve?
lines: Its examples make memory, prediction, and intervention part of the same practical challenge.
Two lights may look perfectly coordinated while depending on entirely different hidden mechanisms.
A useful summary must keep the details that later questions will still need.

title: Ask what happens next
lines: A simple example becomes a demanding question about what a machine really understands.
Begin with what happens next, and ask whether the explanation gives you a way to work it out.

emotionalPlan.purpose: End on the compact representation and a new question it must answer, avoiding an unsupported solved-understanding claim.
